theorem: For the standard exact shared OR-Tseitin proxy compressing a repeated r-input disjunction, maximum deficiency never decreases even when gate inputs remain elsewhere in the formula. If a maximum-deficiency witness touches the compressed block, the transformed formula has a witness of deficiency delta*(F)+r.
formula: if a maxdef witness touches the compressed block: delta*(T_OR(F)) >= delta*(F)+r
proof_accounting: If q of r inputs remain elsewhere after replacement, transformed witness has delta+r-q-1; all r+1 exact definition clauses add q+1 deficiency, totaling delta+r.
supersedes_scope: R44BK's exclusive-input assumption is unnecessary for the standard OR-Tseitin gate once definition-clause debt is fully charged.
still_open: other Boolean functions such as nontrivial XOR/AND-style circuit gates
nonstandard encodings with proved semantic simplification/deletion
operators exploiting the sibling relationship rather than common-subexpression proxying
non-CNF merge representations with exact accounting
